en.Essa rã congelada volta a viver sozinha: This frozen frog comes back to life on its own in spring! And the way it does it is bizarre.
en.O segredo é açúcar. Segue a Maia, que pi: The secret is sugar. Follow Maia, it gets crazier: in the cold, its liver floods the blood with glucose, a natural antifreeze.
en.O gelo fica só do lado de fora das célul: The ice stays only outside the cells. Inside, the sugar keeps them from freezing and bursting.
en.Na primavera, ela descongela de dentro p: In spring, it thaws from the inside out: first the heart comes back, then the brain, and only then the legs.
